title: Business legend
author: Produced by Gregory Brenig ©
description: 🎤 Business Legend is the podcast that strips away the fluff and reveals the raw truth of what it takes to succeed. Hosted by Gregory Brenig — PropTech & FinTech entrepreneur — we dive into unfiltered journeys of founders, disruptors, and professionals who dared to take risks, faced failures, and built legacies. From billion-dollar pivots to personal turning points, discover lessons, mindset shifts, and stories that inspire you to level up. 🚀 Subscribe now and start building your own legend. #BusinessPodcast #StartupStories #GregoryBrenig
